checkout.description: Local clone path lasius operates on (any checkout under the lasius workspace's repos dir or an absolute path). REQUIRED per deployment — set REFACTOR_CHECKOUT or this key.

lasius_root.description: lasius workspace root (--root flag); repo args are checkout paths so any lasius.toml workspace works.

worktree_base.description: Refactor worktrees land at <worktree_base>/wt-<slug(refactor_id)>; the path is re-derived by every node.

base.description: Base branch the worktree branches from — the worktree is created at origin/<base>.

refactor_id.description: Identifier for the refactor — becomes the branch suffix (refactor/<id>) and the worktree slug. REQUIRED. Env fallback: REFACTOR_ID.

refactor_description.description: One-line description woven into every agent prompt. Env fallback: REFACTOR_DESCRIPTION.

spec.description: Path to the spec file the analyze/impl/review agents read (relative to the worktree or absolute). Env fallback: REFACTOR_SPEC.

check_cmd.description: Lint/typecheck command run in the worktree after impl and after each fix. Env fallback: REFACTOR_CHECK_CMD.

test_cmd.description: Test command run in the worktree after check passes. Env fallback: REFACTOR_TEST_CMD.

agent.description: sepia agent-config id for the analyze/impl/fix/review/rework/docs sessions. Env fallback: REFACTOR_AGENT.

agent_mode.description: ACP session mode applied after create (session/set_mode). REQUIRED for unattended runs — devin's default accept-edits prompts on exec and deadlocks. 'bypass' auto-approves all tools; 'smart' is the safer middle ground. Env fallback: REFACTOR_AGENT_MODE.

node_url.description: Base URL of `peregrin serve` (sessions plane). Agent nodes POST /api/sessions/run here; bearer = PEREGRIN_TOKEN.
